title: Patient Financial Services Manual — Final-Notice Paydown for Accounts with Returned Payments or Long Standing
content:
**6.1 Clause.** How the final-notice paydown on the Patient Financial Account is computed depends on the account's history:

- (a) an account with a check or ACH payment returned in the 12 calendar months before the handling date pays the whole paydown base;
- (b) an account with no such return that was opened at least 36 calendar months before the handling date pays the good-faith share, the paydown base multiplied by the good-faith percentage, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end;
- (c) any other account is not paid under (a) or (b).

**6.2 Order of the tests.** Sub-clause (a) is tested first: an account with a returned check or ACH payment in the 12 months pays the whole paydown base however long it has been open.

**6.3 Calendar months.** A window of calendar months for the final-notice paydown ends on the handling date and reaches back that many months, a date on the same calendar day that many months earlier falling outside it. A return dated on the same calendar day 12 months before the handling date is outside the 12 months; an account opened on the same calendar day 36 months before the handling date was opened at least 36 months before it.

**6.4 Records read.** A returned payment is a payment reversal on the account ledger whose method was check or ACH, dated by the date of the reversal; card chargebacks are not check or ACH returns. The opening date is the one recorded on the account.

## Judgement table

| Check or ACH return within 12 months | Account opened 36 or more months ago | Paydown |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | the whole paydown base |
| no | yes | the good-faith share |
| no | no | neither (a) nor (b) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- Paydown base 500.00, one returned ACH payment 4 months ago: the paydown is 500.00.
- Paydown base 500.00, no return, account opened 7 years ago, good-faith percentage 45: the paydown is 500.00 multiplied by 45 percent, that is 225.00.
- Paydown base 333.33, no return, opened 40 months ago, good-faith percentage 55: 333.33 multiplied by 55 percent is 183.3315, rounded once to **183.33**.
